## Recovery synthesis

The sidebar identifies a real weakness in r0.1's recommendation: historical
configuration continuity is a reason to recover the historical control, not
a sufficient scientific reason to begin every new method with JINC.
Ordinary MAP is a clearer first setting for distinguishing protected model,
cleaned residual, model update and state. The feedback projector remains an
explicit choice. A matched containing-pixel illustration can isolate the
restored model contribution without proving the full pipeline has unit
response, is linear, converges or improves the data.

The frozen MAP contract supplies the forward estimator, so new ordinary-map
or PCA derivation would repeat existing science. New work remains the exact
FRUIT method and its upstream handoffs. Ordinary MAP adds its specific PTC
coefficient and support-policy requirements; it does not automatically admit a
FRUIT-rejoined descendant, supply missing selector companions, or make any
uncertainty interpretation true.

The [sanitized scope](author/SCOPE_BRIEF.md) preserves all eleven sections and
the [method proposal](METHOD_RECORD_PROPOSAL.md) retains all twenty-one classes.
The [reference control](PROPOSED_AUTHOR_REFERENCES.md) replaces direct JINC
sources with exact frozen MAP sources for this first scientific author scope.
The internal dossier and source snapshots remain outside that channel.

The feedback prompted this successor proposal; D001–D005 are still pending
exact owner disposition. The predecessor and frozen contracts are preserved
byte-for-byte. No method approval, implementation assessment, author dispatch
or experiment follows from this paper revision.
